{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter for control arm and moderate severity
df_filtered = df_dedup[(df_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & (df_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Compute response fraction
n_patients = len(df_filtered)
n_responded = df_filtered['responded'].sum()
response_fraction = n_responded / n_patients

# Print results
print(f"Number of control-arm, moderate-severity patients: {n_patients}")
print(f"Number who responded: {n_responded}")
print(f"Response fraction: {response_fraction}")"}
